question: Which mantras govern the oblations of cooked offering and parched rice?
premises: Cooked offering is oblated with the Aghora mantra
The Vāma mantra governs the second oblation
inference: After offering cooked rice with Aghora, one should offer parched rice with Vāma
plain_english: Having offered the cooked oblation with the Aghora mantra, one should offer parched rice with the Vāma mantra.
